title: Driverless stacker drives into a standing worker
description: The unmanned stacker advances without slowing and makes contact with a stationary worker at ~4.5 s; the worker is pushed aside and steps away as the stacker continues.

evidence.vlm: Cosmos3-Reason (5 s clip, 4 fps): "the stacker moves forward and strikes the person standing in its path; the person stumbles to the side" → verdict collision (0.88).
evidence.consensus: Collision confirmed: VLM verdict and box overlap agree on 4 of 5 ceiling views.
evidence.pipeline_caption_said: The video shows a warehouse interior with a dark gray tiled floor. A person wearing a white shirt, gray pants, and a white cap stands in the center of the frame. To the right, a blue forklift with black components is visible, positioned near the person. The forklift appears stationary, and there are no visible signs of movement or activity involving the forklift or the person. The environment is clean, with no spills, debris, or other hazards evident. No other workers, inventory, or dock activity are visible in the scene.

title: Worker evades a turning stacker
description: As the stacker turns toward him, the worker spins around and runs clear; the minimum gap closes to ≈0.6 m at ~3.0 s with no braking by the stacker.

evidence.vlm: Cosmos3-Reason: "the forklift turns and moves toward the worker, who turns and runs away to avoid it" → verdict near-miss (0.82).
evidence.consensus: Near-miss: evasive sprint detected by tracking; VLM agrees on 3 of 5 ceiling views.
evidence.pipeline_caption_said: A person wearing a white uniform and cap stands in a warehouse with a blue and black forklift nearby. The forklift, labeled 'ATLAS,' moves slowly forward, approaching the person. The individual then turns and runs away from the forklift, moving toward the right side of the frame. The floor is dark blue with visible wear, and the walls are light-colored brick. No other objects, inventory, or dock activity are visible in the scene.

title: Worker walks into the advancing stacker's path
description: The worker crosses directly in front of the advancing stacker between ~6 s and ~9 s and stops facing it; the stacker does not yield.

evidence.vlm: Cosmos3-Reason: "a person walks in front of the moving forklift and stands in its path" → verdict person in path (0.79).
evidence.consensus: Person-in-path: worker inside the stacker's forward corridor for 2.9 s on 3 ceiling views.
evidence.pipeline_caption_said: A person wearing a light-colored short-sleeved shirt, dark pants, and a cap is walking across a warehouse floor toward a forklift. The forklift is light blue and black with the brand name 'ATLAS' visible on its side. The person approaches the forklift, stops, and stands facing it. The warehouse floor is marked with grid lines, and the lighting casts a warm, orange hue over the scene. No other workers, inventory, or vehicles are visible in the immediate area.

title: Loaded AGV passes within ~1 m of a worker
description: A worker in a blue cap steps into the route of an AGV carrying a pallet with two cartons; the AGV passes within roughly one metre without stopping.

evidence.vlm: Cosmos3-Reason: "a person in a blue cap walks directly into the path of an AGV carrying a pallet with boxes, creating a potential collision risk" (near-miss, approx. 2.0 s).
evidence.consensus: Proximity: VLM interaction + box proximity agree (1 view).

title: AGV with cartons crosses close to an idle worker
description: A yellow AGV carrying cartons crosses the centre of the floor and passes close to a standing worker who is watching it; no evasive action needed.

evidence.vlm: Cosmos3-Reason: "an AGV transports boxes past a person standing nearby, observing it" (no interaction).
evidence.consensus: Low-risk proximity: kinematics only; VLM saw no interaction.
evidence.pipeline_caption_said: The scene takes place in a large, open warehouse with a gray tiled floor and white walls. Several individuals are present, including workers in safety gear and others in casual clothing. A yellow automated guided vehicle (AGV) is moving across the floor, carrying a stack of brown cardboard boxes. The AGV is positioned near the center of the frame and is actively transporting the load. A person in a purple top and red pants is standing nearby, observing the AGV's movement. Other individuals are scattered around the warehouse, some walking and others standing still. The overall activity suggests a routine operation within a logistics or manufacturing environment.
